reference_role: style and color reference; no reused artwork

concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original cute and mildly goofy open-source developer-tool mascot for Shell Buddy, a tiny fast terminal assistant. The supplied image is a STYLE/COLOR REFERENCE ONLY: Zun's multicolor hummingbird. Learn its crisp colored regions and lively tiny eye; DO NOT copy its silhouette, exact pose, wordmark, or lettering. Combine that clear brand craft with the endearingly awkward appeal of the Go gopher: imperfect-looking huge eyes, curious expression, funny proportions, instantly lovable personality. This is a colorful CHARACTER with a face and anatomy, not a monochrome abstract animal silhouette. Clean contemporary 2D vector mascot illustration with gently rounded geometric forms, a consistent thin deep-navy contour, 3-5 carefully separated colors and a single restrained cel-shaded region per body part. Mostly flat color with subtle tonal facets is fine. No photorealism, 3D, fur texture, glossy plastic, metallic effects, complex lighting, corporate esports shield or gradients over the entire image. One full-body animal centered in a square, 15% clean transparent padding, strong readable small-size silhouette. Big white eye sclera, tiny asymmetrical navy pupils, tiny expressive mouth, charming mischievous energy, affectionate not menacing. Actual transparent background; no white rectangle, no scenic background, no shadow or ground, no text, labels, watermark, framing or extra copies. Subject: an ORIGINAL little squat gecko/iguana inspired by the animal family of Zig's mascot but not redrawing Ziggy or Zero. Turquoise pear-shaped body and head, lighter mint belly, three small indigo dorsal spikes, short chunky four legs with simplified mitten toes, curled indigo-tipped tail wrapping around its foot. Face turned three-quarter toward viewer; two bulging round white eyes at slightly different heights, one tiny coral tongue sticking sideways out of a pleased crooked grin. No clothes or held objects. The expression is 'I found the command, probably'. Compact adorable proportions with a head nearly as large as its body. Palette turquoise #27C8B3, mint #B7F2D5, indigo #6557D8, tiny coral #F26B7B, ink #172236.
